title: No Ctrl+S to apply the canvas graph, and the shortcut set is undiscoverable
existing_state: Applying the canvas back to YAML is only reachable via the Toolbar 'Apply YAML' button (FlowCanvas/src/panels/Toolbar.tsx:57-63, 219-221). The central shortcut handler (hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts:26-157) wires Ctrl+Z/Y/C/V/F, Delete, Escape, Ctrl+Enter (test step), F5 (run), F10 (debug step) — but no Ctrl+S, the muscle-memory 'save' every editor user presses; in the WebView2 host it currently does nothing. None of these shortcuts (notably F5/F10/Ctrl+Enter) are listed anywhere in the UI — discovery is via button tooltips or source code.
recommendation: Add a Ctrl+S branch in useKeyboardShortcuts that sends the same applyYaml payload as Toolbar.handleApplyYaml (guard on exportStatus.hasErrors like F5 does). Add a '?' / Ctrl+/ keyboard-shortcut cheat-sheet overlay (a static panel like SearchOverlay) listing the bindings, and mention Ctrl+S in the Apply button tooltip.
user_benefit: Matches the save reflex from VS Code-class tools and makes the existing power shortcuts (F5 run, F10 step, Ctrl+Enter test) actually findable.

evidence.note: complete shortcut list; no Ctrl+S, no help overlay binding
